claims.claim: Positive research materialization requires explicit upstream witnesses and can never manufacture canonical genesis authority.
Conservation/bookkeeping arithmetic can be exact when all source energy and efficiency intervals are supplied.
Redox/electron-transfer and free-energy constraints are central to known terrestrial metabolism.
Bioavailable nutrient limitation and co-limitation strongly regulate terrestrial productivity; total elemental inventory is not equivalent to biological availability.
Ecological interaction networks are useful representations, but topology alone does not establish causal specialization, stability or coextinction risk.
Population counts can be conserved under explicitly supplied births, deaths and stage transitions without assuming an endogenous universal growth law.
Stage-structured demographic models are useful Earth-calibrated abstractions when lifecycle stages and rates are explicit inputs.
Mutation, selection, drift and migration are established mechanisms of terrestrial evolution; their mapping to deep-time macroevolution is not universal or complete.
Speciation assessment must be criterion/evidence bound; no universal scalar trait-distance or rate is authorized.
Zero modeled population establishes demographic extinction in that model state; predictive extinction rates remain model- and context-bound.
Known multicellular complexity involves cooperation, division of labour, development and interdependence; it is not a generic automatic consequence of time.
Synthetic organism proposals may be constrained by explicit environment, ecological role, inherited lineage envelopes and lifecycle state, but no alien body plan is predicted.
Earth taxonomy must not be universalized to extraterrestrial lineages.
Fixture trait values and morphology envelopes exist only to test deterministic/reconciliation semantics.
No predictive abiogenesis probability, universal trigger or canonical genesis law is established; WV-C does not implement one.
COLD/WARM/HOT/IMMEDIATE refinement can preserve coarse commitments and keep organism samples ephemeral without creating new truth.

blockers: Exact Wave V shared base/ownership manifest unresolved at research freeze time unless separately supplied by Prompt 0.
No canonical P5 positive environment/energy/nutrient/redox authority exists for life.
No canonical predictive abiogenesis model exists.
Exobiology morphology/taxonomy claims are not empirically validated.
Cross-runtime certification and any future migration contract require a separate promotion transaction.
